name: Quality Harvest Foods Corp.
old_description: Discover the innovation and quality that make us a trusted partner in the baking industry.
about:
Quality Harvest Foods Corp. was established in 1964 in Portland, Oregon, when it introduced pita bread to the U.S. market. The company operates from a 150,000-square-foot facility in Portland's industrial hub, strategically located near Portland International Airport and Interstates 84 and 205.

As a contract manufacturer, Quality Harvest Foods produces individually frozen, fully finished sweet and savory bakery items such as filled sticks, bites, handhelds, and pull-aparts, along with pizza crusts. Its two production lines handle dough preparation, filling (including dual-filling capability), baking, and advanced packaging—individually wrapped oven/microwave-safe items, multi-packs, resealable stand-up pouches, and bulk formats. The facility employs approximately 270 people and runs 24-hour production.

The company serves food manufacturers, retail brands, foodservice operators, and K‑12 school nutrition programs. Its national account manager for K‑12 indicates a focus on the education segment, while its custom bakery solutions cater to brands seeking proprietary formulations and co‑packed products.

Quality Harvest Foods differentiates itself through an allergen‑limited facility (milk and wheat only), BRCGS Food Safety Certification with an A+ rating (2023) and A rating (2024), and a zero‑recall history. In‑house R&D develops proprietary dough flavors and fillings, and the company uses RedZone manufacturing software for real‑time production monitoring.

name: Quality Packaging Supply Corporation
old_description: Quality Packaging Supply Corporation offers the industry’s best range of poly and paper based packaging products that are used across numerous retail, foodservice, agricultural, janitorial and industrial applications.
about:
Quality Packaging Supply Corporation is headquartered in Anaheim, California. The company provides flexible packaging solutions for a range of industries.

The company supplies poly- and paper-based packaging products including bags, shrink wrap, films, promotional bags, tape, and agricultural packaging. It offers custom capabilities such as made-to-order bags in any size, shape, thickness, or material, along with graphic design and printing up to 12 colors. Both stock and custom items are available.

Quality Packaging serves foodservice, medical, aerospace, retail, agricultural, and industrial customers. Its products are used in applications ranging from foodservice stretch film and aluminum foil to industrial and medical packaging.

The company emphasizes direct factory pricing, dedicated 24/7 support across the United States, and guaranteed on-time delivery. It positions itself as a partner that improves supply chain dynamics through timely delivery of high-quality custom and stock flexible packaging solutions.

name: Quality Plastics & Engineering
old_description: Discover top-tier engineering and manufacturing services at QPE Corporation. We specialize in delivering custom wire harnesses, electromechanical assemblies, and high-quality plastic injection-molded products to meet the specific needs of diverse industries.
about:
QPE Corporation, doing business as Quality Plastics & Engineering, operates from Elkhart, Indiana. The company provides custom wire harnesses, electromechanical assemblies, and plastic injection-molded products for a range of industrial markets.

Its manufacturing facility houses eight injection molding machines with clamping forces from 123 to 398 tons and shot capacities of 3.4 to 30.2 ounces, enabling both small intricate parts and large production runs. The wire harness department builds custom assemblies using discrete wire and multi-conductor cables, handling design, assembly, and testing in-house. Engineering support relies on AutoDesk Inventor for 3D modeling and AutoCAD for 2D prints, and the company reports that 95 percent of its equipment is less than ten years old.

QPE serves the transportation, off-road, medical, recreational vehicle, consumer goods, work truck, and electronics sectors. Customers include manufacturers of heavy-duty trucks, off-road equipment, medical devices, RVs, and electronic assemblies.

The company emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certified quality system, on-time delivery, and a collaborative approach that includes statistical process control on request. It positions itself as a partner for innovation, competitive pricing, and flexible, agile manufacturing.

name: Quality Wood & Metal Designs
old_description: Quality Wood Designs specializes in solving problems. With a clear focus on retail security and merchandising solutions, we have a deep catalog of products tailored to meet your specific needs.
about:
Quality Wood & Metal Designs operates from Mitchell, South Dakota, where it was founded in 1961 by Vic Honermann. The business remains family-owned; Vic’s son Mike took over in the 1980s and now runs the company with his wife, Jo Ann.

The shop provides full-service custom fabrication in wood and metal, housing a woodshop, laser cutting, brake press forming, powder coating, and finishing under one roof. In-house drafting and design, store layout planning, warehousing, and custom fixturing allow the team to take projects from concept to finished product without outsourcing.

The company serves retail, residential, equipment, and safety‑and‑security markets, with a noted focus on firearms merchandising. Customers range from independent gun shops such as BattleHawk Armory to multinational corporations, and the product line includes gondola systems, secure display cases, and the Gun Warden home firearm storage unit.

Quality Wood & Metal Designs emphasizes a problem‑solving approach rooted in Midwestern ethics — service, hard work, good value, and dependability. It promotes its Made‑in‑the‑USA manufacturing and on‑site capabilities as a way to meet tight timelines and budgets consistently.

name: Quantum Composers
old_description: A leading manufacturer of regenerative periodontal therapy devices turned to Quantum Composers to double their production to meet dental laser demands. Quantum produced 200 6-watt free-running variable
about:
Quantum Composers is based in Bozeman, Montana, where it has designed and manufactured precision timing and photonics instruments for more than three decades. The company was founded over 30 years ago and remains privately held; no founders are named in public materials.

The product line centers on digital delay generators, pulse generators, current generators, and laser systems, including Nd:YAG lasers. Quantum Composers also provides custom engineering services such as FPGA and firmware development, multi-board synchronization architectures, and environmental hardening for vibration, temperature, or radiation. The firm supports OEM customers through full lifecycle and production support, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers include university research labs, aerospace and defense contractors, medical and dental device manufacturers, and spectroscopy and material science facilities. A noted example is a regenerative periodontal therapy device maker that engaged Quantum Composers to double production of 6-watt free-running variable dental lasers. The company also supplies current pulsers and firesets for pyrotechnics and aerospace applications.

Quantum Composers emphasizes collaborative design, stating it does not simply sell timing devices but works to build precision into the design from day one. It backs its instruments with multi-year warranties and lifetime service, and offers re-calibration, programming assistance, and RMA support through its photonics experts.

name: Quarter Sawn Millwork Group (Custom Woodwork NYC) (QSMG)
old_description: is a team of master craftsmen with 30+ years of experience serving New York City and beyond. Specializing in millwork, glasswork, and metalwork, we bring precision and artistry to projects of every scale—from full build-outs to custom one-offs.
about:
Quarter Sawn Millwork Group operates from New York City, serving the five boroughs as well as New Jersey and Connecticut. The company describes its team as master craftsmen with more than 30 years of experience, though a specific founding year is not published. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed in the available material.

The shop combines millwork, glasswork, and metalwork under one roof, handling design, fabrication, and installation without subcontracting. A full weld shop, a dedicated glass shop, and advanced CNC equipment—including Thermwood 3‑axis and 5‑axis machines—allow production of custom built‑ins, radiator covers, Murphy beds, bathroom vanities, kitchens, walk‑in closets, and one‑off furniture pieces. Projects range from single residential items to multi‑floor commercial build‑outs such as hotel lobbies, airline lounges, and full restaurant renovations.

Clients span hospitality, retail, commercial office, and high‑end residential sectors. Named accounts include Irving Farm Coffee Roasters, Partners Coffee, Le Pain Quotidien, The Gap, Saks Fifth Avenue, Estée Lauder, Air France, Turkish Airlines, Simpson Thacher & Bartlett LLP, The Mercer Hotel, The Shubert Theater Group, and numerous other NYC venues. The firm has also collaborated with general contractors such as LCM Construction on projects like the Bedford, Brooklyn Partners Coffee location.

QSMG emphasizes that its in‑house model—designers, fabricators, and installers working together—delivers consistent quality and accountability. The company highlights its agility and turnaround speed despite a small team, and points to its ELLE Decor feature for the Gramercy Park Penthouse project as external validation of its craftsmanship.

name: Quick Cable Corporation
old_description: QuickCable® is a leading U.S.-based manufacturer of battery connection solutions, proudly delivering American-made quality and innovation for more than 80 years. From battery to application, we connect it all™ through a broad portfolio of terminal connectors, cable assemblies, tools, and custom-engineered power solutions designed for demanding commercial vehicle, industrial, agricultural, construction, military/defense, material handling, marine, and specialty applications. Backed by deep engineering expertise, manufacturing excellence, and the QuickEverything™ commitment to comprehensive power connectivity solutions, QuickCable helps customers improve reliability, performance, and operational efficiency in mission-critical environments.
about:
Quick Cable Corporation, operating as QuickCable®, is headquartered in Franksville, Wisconsin, with a second manufacturing and distribution site in Mississauga, Ontario. The company was founded in 1946 by Jack Shannon and has grown from a specialty battery maker into a manufacturer of battery connection solutions for commercial and industrial markets.

QuickCable engineers and manufactures a broad portfolio of terminal connectors, cable assemblies, tools, and custom-engineered power solutions. Its in-house capabilities include die-casting, stamping, machining, cable assembly, plastic molding, printing, non-ferrous metal casting, and wire and cable fabrication. The combined facilities support a workforce of approximately 150 employees and serve global distribution.

The company serves industries including material handling, standby power and generation, heavy-duty truck and bus, automotive, recreation, agriculture, electrical, powersports, commercial vehicles, construction, marine, and military/defense. Its customer base comprises OEMs, wire harness assemblers, distributors, dealers, and retailers seeking custom-designed connectors, cable assemblies, and battery accessories.

QuickCable states its mission is to drive customer success through leadership and innovation in the energy storage industry, emphasizing American-made quality and a product offering described as the broadest and most comprehensive in the industry. The company highlights its QuickEverything™ commitment to comprehensive power connectivity solutions and value-added distribution services as key differentiators.

name: Quilter's Corner
old_description: Join Robin & Lora every Friday morning at 9:30 AM CST. They adore getting dressed up in wacky costumes and have been going LIVE every Friday since 2020!
about:
Quilter's Corner opened in 2020 in Faulkton, South Dakota, founded by Robin and Lora. The shop began as a local quilt fabric retailer and quickly added live-streamed shopping events to reach a broader audience.

The store carries a wide range of quilting cottons, batiks, flannels, and specialty lines such as Liberty, Tilda, and Moda, along with pre-cut bundles, quilt kits, patterns, notions, batting, and interfacing. It also serves as an authorized Janome dealer, stocking models from the Travel Mate, Skyline, and Memory Craft series. In addition to retail, the shop offers longarm quilting services and hosts quarterly three-day retreats with catered meals and dedicated sewing stations.

The business serves individual quilters and sewing enthusiasts both in-store and through its online shop, which features live shopping shows every Friday and Monday. Customers include hobbyists seeking curated mystery kits, such as the quarterly Mystery Five-0 series, as well as those purchasing machines and supplies for home studios.

The founders emphasize a personal touch, with live hosts in costume, real-time demos, and a commitment to helping every visitor find the right materials. The retreat program and mystery-kit subscriptions are designed to build community around the craft.

about:
R.I. Welding & Fabricating Co. operates from Providence, Rhode Island, where it has been serving New England industrial clients for more than five decades. The company was established over 50 years ago, though a precise founding year is not publicly documented, and no founder names or ownership structure are disclosed in available sources.

The shop specializes in the fabrication of stainless steel, aluminum, and mild steel, producing both semi-finished and fully fabricated metal components. Its 16,000-square-foot facility is equipped with bridge cranes and monorail systems, complemented by a 30,000-square-foot enclosed yard. A workforce of 15 employees handles structural steel fabrication, metal pan stairs, and ornamental iron railings, with installation services offered on site. The company also operates its own delivery trucks and portable welders to support field work at customer plants or job sites.

The company serves a broad base of New England industries, with its product lineup pointing to construction, industrial maintenance, and architectural metalwork sectors. Typical projects include structural steel assemblies, stair systems, and decorative railings for commercial and industrial buildings.

R.I. Welding emphasizes its long regional tenure and the ability to deliver both shop-fabricated and field-installed metalwork from a single source, supported by in-house lifting equipment and mobile welding capability.
